title: Expand regional governance and operation models
requirements:
- Distinguish components governed regionally but operated nationally from components operated once regionally as a shared service
- State who performs release, service-level, conformance, trust-list and incident coordination for components shared across countries
- Address multilingual interoperability, maturity and capacity differences across participating countries
- Present binding regional authority as one model among mutual recognition, coordinated national decisions and voluntary adoption
- Define handoffs between regional and national authorities
- Offer cost-sharing options with solidarity mechanisms protecting lower-resource participants
